name: stale-script-remediation
description: Trigger: (1) workflow scripts not propagating to projects, (2) qc_report.py or log_utils.py failures in deployed projects, (3) bulk-updating Snakemake workflow scripts across KINTSUGI_Projects, (4) stale Snakemake locks blocking batch processing, (5) batch processing stalls after workflow/scripts updates. Verified on 35 configured projects (Feb 2026).
